answer_1.quote: Gender-fair rewriting is a conditional text generation problem. It can be approached with conventional sequence-to-sequence models trained on large amounts of parallel data, i.e., biased segments S and their gender-fair counterparts T.
answer_1.outputs: The police officers search for a capable leader.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our English model outputs and compare them to previous work with tokenised WER based on the Python package jiwer.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human quality rating experiment to assess whether the imperfect outputs of this model are perceived as more gender-fair and whether erroneous gender-fair forms in general are preferred over unaltered gender-biased text.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are shown a single paragraph at a time and asked if that paragraph is gender-fair, which they answer using a 5-point Likert scale (1: strongly disagree, 5: strongly agree).
